description: This file defines the SubfinderProcessor class, which implements the IProcessor interface to process a command job by reading a file, parsing JSON lines to extract host information, and creating assets based on that data.

classes.name: SubfinderProcessor
classes.description: A processor class responsible for handling subdomain discovery using the Subfinder tool, integrating with the application by implementing IProcessor.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes a command job by reading a file, parsing each line as JSON to extract host information, and creating assets to return as the result.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Property returning the name identifier for this processor ('Subfinder').

methods.name: Description
methods.description: Property providing a description of the processor ('Subfinder integration').

methods.name: ExternalUrl
methods.description: Property containing the URL to the Subfinder project repository.

methods.name: IsConfigured
methods.description: Property indicating whether the processor is configured (true).
